cases.evidence_note: Inputs are stage16.small.s4 as the interview asks them, for a person whose only HSA item is one the tool does not support (a qualified HSA funding distribution from an IRA, a testing-period failure or an inherited HSA): Form 8889 is answered for the person and the unsupported-HSA-situations question Yes. The interview asks that question straight after the Form 8889 roster and stops at the refusal, so no contribution or distribution amount is asked.
